name: Grouped Deck Panels
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Deck headers with key, phrase and mix hints in 4 DECK, 2/4 DECK and 2 DECK.
description: Input-transparent deck headers beside the stock BPM: title, original Camelot key, relative phrase counter. Mix hints: key turns green/amber/red against the longest-playing other deck, the deck number turns amber at 30 s and red at 10 s left, a dot shows stems (filled = playing, hollow = found), and a small BPM gap appears within 8 BPM. Works in 4 DECK, 2/4 DECK and 2 DECK (Two-deck view: Auto follows the last layout tab tapped, or pick it). No audio, tempo, key or library changes.
